# HaruMusic 0.1.10

- Remove the local dark gradient under Android player controls so the album atmosphere continues to the bottom edge.
- Give the preferred music source a 350ms head start, then allow at most two enabled sources to resolve concurrently. Use the first verified result at that source's highest supported quality; stop scheduling additional sources once a result wins. URL-cache writes no longer delay playback startup.
- Add native Android DownloadManager integration, a download list, progress, cancellation, re-resolution retry and confirmed deletion. Downloads continue in the system background. Completed tracks can be played offline inside HaruMusic, including after reopening the app. Android 10+ uses Music/HaruMusic; older Android versions use app-specific Music storage.
- Add a brief, skippable intro using the shared desktop logo; honor reduced-motion preferences and allow Back to dismiss it.
- Improve mobile playback button semantics, keyboard access, touch targets and accessibility appearance fallbacks. See docs/HIG-AUDIT-0.1.10.md for inspected areas and remaining device-level acceptance checks.

Validation: 148 unit tests, TypeScript, Android Java compilation, embedded streaming/cancellation smoke checks, and mobile browser UI checks with a native bridge fixture. Automated approval blocked the emulator APK installation/download integration command; actual native download completion and real-network playback latency remain unverified on a physical phone. This release does not claim full HIG compliance or universal source availability.
